tierReason: Adds email/password auth, the first user data, the first Prisma schema and migration, and new public API endpoints

findings.text: apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:85,92-97 — sign-in limiter checks isBlocked before the slow lookup+scrypt and records the failure only afterwards, so N parallel wrong-password requests for one email all pass the check: far more than 5 guesses per 15 min (R12). Fix: reserve a pending slot atomically with the check (tryAcquire), convert to failure or release after; add a test with 10 parallel wrong attempts expecting at most 5 password checks.

apps/api/src/app.ts:14 — trust proxy hard-coded to 1: when the API is reached directly (dev LAN now), a client can spoof X-Forwarded-For so each request is a new IP and the 20-per-IP limit never triggers; behind more than one proxy all users share one bucket (R12). Fix: read TRUST_PROXY from env, default off, document in .env.example, test that a spoofed X-Forwarded-For doesn't change the bucket when off.

apps/api/src/auth/rate-limit.ts:26-36 — maps only prune keys that are looked up again, so failures for many distinct emails/IPs stay in memory for the life of the process. Suggest a periodic sweep or size cap.

apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:65,74 — sign-up creates user then session in two writes; if createSession fails the account exists without a returned token and a retry gets email_in_use. Suggest one transaction or nested create.
apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:59 — sign-up has no rate limit: unlimited scrypt hashing (CPU) and an unthrottled email-exists lookup alongside the accepted R5 leak. Suggest a per-IP limit.

apps/api/src/http/errors.ts:66 — logs full message+stack of unexpected errors; Prisma's default pretty error format can include query arguments (email, hash). Suggest errorFormat minimal in createPrismaClient or log only name and Prisma code.
apps/api/src/auth/sessions.ts:42 — lastUsedAt is touched at most hourly, so expiry can land up to 1 hour before '90 days after last use' (R9). Harmless; state it.
apps/mobile/.env.example — plain HTTP on the dev LAN carries passwords and tokens unencrypted; #3 must use HTTPS.
R12 per-email rule lets a third party lock a real user out for 15 minutes with 5 failures. Follows the spec; recorded as an accepted trade-off.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx setLanguage — if PATCH /me fails (offline or server error) the error is swallowed and the UI shows the choice as saved; on next launch getMe returns the old account value and syncLanguage overwrites the local choice, so the app silently reverts (R24, frontend checklist 'failed requests give a clear message'). Also a SecureStore failure in saveLanguageChoice becomes an unhandled rejection via void setLanguage(lang) in settings.tsx.

apps/api/src/test/helpers.ts + vitest.global-setup.ts — every run truncates User/Session in one shared test database, so two concurrent runs (other worktrees, parallel reviewers) wipe each other's rows and tests flake (seen by both reviewers). Suggest a per-run schema or documenting one run at a time.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx endSession — the previous account's language choice survives sign-out, so the sign-in screen keeps it instead of the phone's language (R23); matters when someone else signs in on the same phone.

apps/mobile/src/app/(auth)/sign-in.tsx and sign-up.tsx — invalid={error !== null} paints the password field red for every error (network, email_in_use, too_many_attempts), and validation errors are one generic message though the server names the field (DESIGN.md: field errors under the field).
Test coverage vs acceptance criteria: R10 random/expired token are tested only on a stub app, not on /me itself; R13 shape is mostly asserted via error.code only, not {error:{code,message}}.

apps/api/src/http/errors.ts:78 — other body-parser 4xx errors (unsupported charset/encoding 415, aborted 400) fall into the generic 500 branch and get logged, so a client's own mistake looks like a server error (R13). Fix: if err.status is 4xx and err.expose, answer with that status and a stable code like bad_request.

apps/api/src/auth/password.ts:51-56 — dummyHash caches the first hashPassword promise; if it ever rejects, every unknown-email sign-in returns 500 while known emails get 401, revealing which accounts exist. Fix: clear the cache on rejection or compute it at startup.

apps/api/src/app.ts:16 + .env.example — rollout note for #3: TRUST_PROXY=0 behind Render's proxy makes all clients share one IP (20 failures lock out all sign-ins, sign-up capped at 10 per 15 min for everyone); too high a value lets clients spoof IPs. #3 must set the exact hop count and verify req.ip.

apps/api/vitest.global-setup.ts:14 — the guard compares TEST_DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL as exact strings; two different strings for the same database pass and the tests would TRUNCATE dev tables. Fix: compare parsed host/port/database name, or require the test database name to end in _test.

apps/api/src/auth/sessions.ts:44 — expired and abandoned session rows are never deleted, and a server session stays valid up to 90 days after an offline sign-out (R20 accepts this). Fix later: delete rows where lastUsedAt < now - 90d.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx:187-197 + src/lib/api.ts:39 — signOut awaits apiSignOut before endSession and request() has no timeout; with the network up but the LAN server unreachable (cellular/other Wi-Fi) the fetch hangs ~60 s with no feedback, the token stays in the Keychain, and killing the app leaves it signed in (R20: sign out even if the server can't be reached). Fix: endSession first, fire-and-forget apiSignOut; AbortController timeout in request() mapped to ApiError('network').

apps/mobile/src/lib/api.ts:39 — no request timeout, so an unreachable-but-online server leaves sign-in/sign-up spinning ~60 s before the R19 no-connection message (covered by the timeout in the blocking fix).

apps/mobile AuthProvider.tsx:90-130 + settings.tsx:43 — the pending-sync note says 'when you're online' but retries happen only at launch, after sign-in or on the next tap; after an offline launch languagePendingSync stays false so the note hides. Fix: read the stored flag at launch and retry when the app returns to the foreground, or reword.

apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:69 + rate-limit.ts:4 — the sign-up limit (10 per IP per 15 min, counting invalid bodies) isn't recorded in the spec or plan; friends on one shop Wi-Fi could block each other. Fix: record it in the spec as a deliberate addition, or count only valid attempts.
apps/mobile/.gitignore:34 — only .env*.local is ignored, while .env.example invites a local .env that Expo reads; a .env could be committed by mistake (R28). Fix: add .env.

apps/api/src/auth/rate-limit.ts tryAcquire (used via req.ip in routes.ts) — IP limits key on the exact address; an IPv6 host controls a /64, so rotating addresses gets past the sign-in IP limit (password spraying across emails) and the sign-up limit (unlimited scrypt). The per-email limit still holds. Fix: bucket IPv6 by /64 after normalising IPv4-mapped addresses, or defer to #3.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx setLanguage and flushPendingLanguage catches — on not_signed_in they call endSession() without checking tokenRef.current === token, so a slow request from a signed-out account A can sign out a newer account B on the same phone. Fix: return early when the token changed.

apps/api/src/me/routes.ts PATCH — existence check and update are separate, so a user deleted in between raises P2025 → 500. Unreachable today (no account deletion). Fix: updateMany and return 401 when count is 0.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx flushPendingLanguage + setLanguage — a background retry and a fresh Settings tap can overlap; the retry clears the pending flag without checking the stored choice still equals what it sent, so the account can stay 'en' while the phone shows 'vi', and the next launch silently switches back (R24/R26). Fix: re-read the choice after success and clear the flag only if unchanged, or route setLanguage through the same one-at-a-time path.

apps/mobile/src/lib/api.ts request() — clearTimeout runs right after fetch resolves, so the 15 s timeout covers only the headers; a stalled body leaves sign-in spinning indefinitely instead of the R19 no-connection message. Fix: clear the timer after reading the body and map an abort there to ApiError('network').

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthForm.tsx:26 parses the human-readable validation message from apps/api/src/http/errors.ts:61 ('Invalid fields: email, password.') to mark fields, so that wording has become an implicit API contract (R13 says message is free text). Fix: pin the format with an API test and document it, or add a structured fields array deliberately.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx flushPendingLanguage — if A's flush is in flight when A signs out and B signs in, B's flush only sets rerunRef and A's run returns early on the token change without picking it up, so B's pending language reaches the account only at the next foreground or launch. No data loss. Fix: restart the flush for the current token on those early returns, or reset the refs in endSession.

apps/mobile/src/auth/token-store.ts — iOS keeps Keychain items after the app is deleted, so a reinstall opens signed in as the previous account. Fits R15/R16; record as known behaviour or clear the token on first launch after install.

apps/api/package.json scripts + .gitignore (/generated/prisma) — nothing runs prisma generate: no postinstall/pretest/prebuild, and global setup runs only migrate deploy. On a fresh clone or in CI, npm test / npm run build fail with 'Cannot find module ../generated/prisma/client.js'. Fix: add postinstall 'prisma generate --config prisma7.config.ts'.

apps/mobile src/app/(auth)/sign-in.tsx, sign-up.tsx, (app)/index.tsx — text links are about 37pt tall (paddingVertical 8 + lineHeight 21), below DESIGN.md's 44pt touch target. Fix: minHeight layout.controlHeight with centring, or hitSlop.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthForm.tsx:41-42 — header tile hard-codes 48x48 instead of DESIGN.md's 52x48 tile; the plan says Review checks no component hard-codes sizes. Fix: add a tile size token and use it.

apps/api/src/auth/password.ts:91-101 dummyVerify — the dummy hash is built lazily, so the first unknown-email sign-in after each process start costs two scrypt runs vs one for a known email: a small, repeatable timing difference against R7, reopened on every Render wake-up (#3). Fix: build it at startup or use a precomputed constant.

apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:39,46 + sign-up.tsx maxLength={50} — zod min/max and RN maxLength count UTF-16 code units, not characters (R3, R4): 26 emoji are refused as a 50-char name, 4 emoji pass as an 8-char password. Fix: count code points in a refine (optionally NFC-normalise), or state the unit in the spec.

apps/api/src/auth/rate-limit.ts:7,135 + R12 — the 50-per-email cap applies even with the right password, so someone with 3 IPv4 addresses or one IPv6 /48 can keep a person locked out; on shared mobile IPv4 (CGNAT) strangers can use up the 20-per-IP and 10-sign-up limits for everyone. Spec accepts the first part. Revisit in #3 (e.g. let a known device past the email-wide cap).

apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts:46-48 — passwords aren't NFC-normalised while display names are; a Vietnamese password with diacritics typed in decomposed form on another keyboard would fail though it looks identical. Fix now, while no stored hashes exist: normalize('NFC') before hashing and verifying.

apps/api/src/auth/sessions.ts:71-83 — a sign-out landing between lookup and lastUsedAt update lets that one in-flight request still succeed. Harmless today; treat update count 0 as not signed in if it ever matters.

apps/api/src/test/helpers.ts:37-39 + vitest.global-setup.ts — the first TRUNCATE of a run failed once with an empty Prisma error (2 tests in app.test.ts), and an identical rerun passed; likely a cold Neon connection. testing.md: a test that fails sometimes is a bug. Fix: warm the connection with retries in beforeAll, or raise the test connection timeout.
apps/mobile/src/ui/Card.tsx:16 — paddingVertical spacing[0] (4pt) vs DESIGN.md's 12–16 card padding; the Settings language card has 4pt above the first row (R21).

apps/mobile sign-in.tsx:55-62, sign-up.tsx:66-73, ui/Screen.tsx:39-49 — the form error and the switch link sit in the bottom footer with the primary button; DESIGN.md says only a form's main button may sit at the bottom.

apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/index.tsx:16-22 — no loading or offline state: while getMe is pending or after an offline launch, user is null and the screen shows only the Settings link, with no placeholder or offline note (DESIGN.md States, frontend checklist).

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx:97-99 endSession — if deleteToken() fails it is swallowed and the token stays in the Keychain; with the fire-and-forget server sign-out also failing, the next launch reopens the old (still valid) session, e.g. on a shared phone. Needs two failures. Fix: retry once, then a signed-out marker checked at launch.

apps/mobile/src/auth/token-store.ts:32-35 clearKeychainOnFreshInstall — if marker.create() throws (storage full) every launch wipes the token and signs the person out; updating from a build without the marker signs out once. Fix: catch a failed create separately; note the one-time sign-out in the Test Handoff.

apps/api/src/index.ts:11-16 — TRUST_PROXY accepts any non-negative integer; a typo like 10 behind Render's single proxy trusts client X-Forwarded-For hops and bypasses per-IP limits. Fix: log the value at startup and refuse values above a small bound (e.g. 3).

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx:222-223 + (app)/index.tsx:19 — a launch getMe failing with anything other than not_signed_in/network (e.g. 500) leaves profileStatus 'loading' forever: endless skeleton, no message or retry (frontend checklist, DESIGN.md States). Fix: an 'error' status with errors.generic and retry.

apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx:233 + (app)/index.tsx:17 — after an offline launch, returning to the foreground only retries the language sync; Home keeps saying Offline until a cold start and never learns of a revoked session (R17). Fix: refetch getMe on 'active' when profileStatus !== 'ready'.

apps/mobile/src/auth/token-store.ts:31-35 (called at AuthProvider.tsx:192) — clearKeychainOnFreshInstall shares the try with reading the token; a persistent marker/delete failure signs the person out on every launch (R15). Fix: its own try/catch, or create the marker before deleting.
